s523c is path-dependent on entry price due to ATR-based stops (STOP_MULT=5.0). A 0.2% shift in entry price moves the stop level by 0.2%. IMPLICATION: optimizing s523c execution timing is meaningless — any shift re-rolls the stop-trigger lottery. The live runner's consistent execution is itself load-bearing. Future overlays should prefer state-based rules (like Mission P) over price-based rules to avoid this cascade.
